text: Stein: 'the process of discovery is often intuitive as well as analytic.' K4 written out in rows of 7, 8, 13, 14, 21, 24 and 31, the known letters marked, and every pattern noted before any code.

Six patterns: the letter K lining up in two columns of seven, five S's crowded together, repeated letter pairs and their spacings, three U's two apart; each counted on a thousand shufflings of K4's letters.
Nothing beats every shuffling; the strongest two (1 in 250) were picked out by eye among many possible patterns. No new item.
